newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,395 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,395 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,395 contracts compared with 1,511 overnight Sunday.
There were 152 wheat, 417 corn, 653 soybean, 58 soymeal, 12 soyoil, 19 oat, three corn calls, 10 corn puts, 60 soybean calls and 11 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 3/4 cent lower to 1/4 cent higher, corn was steady to 1/4 cent lower and soybeans were 2-1/2 cents higher to 1/2 lower.
